export type Verdict = "allow" | "deny" | "would-deny" | "override" | "skip" | "fail-open"

export type GateKind = "tool" | "agent"

export type Probabilities = Record<string, number>

export type FailureKind = "timeout" | "network" | "server" | "bad-request" | "malformed" | "circuit-open"

export type ClefSuccess = { ok: true; probabilities: Probabilities; latencyMs: number; inputTokens?: number }
export type ClefFailure = { ok: false; kind: FailureKind; message: string; status?: number; latencyMs: number }
export type ClefResult = ClefSuccess | ClefFailure

export type Decision = {
  kind: GateKind
  tool: string
  argsHash: string
  argsChars: number
  summary: string
  verdict: Verdict
  reason: string
  result?: ClefResult
  resultChars?: number
  ts?: string
}
